mapper.sql: c.ChapterId, c.StoryId, c.VolumeId, c.ChapterNo, c.Title, c.WordCount, c.Status, c.ScheduledAt, c.PublishedAt, c.ViewCount, c.CreatedAt, c.UpdatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dbo.Chapter c WHERE c.StoryId = #{storyId} AND c.IsDeleted = 0 ORDER BY c.ChapterNo
SELECT , c.Content FROM dbo.Chapter c JOIN dbo.Story s ON s.StoryId = c.StoryId WHERE c.ChapterId = #{chapterId} AND c.IsDeleted = 0 AND s.AuthorId = #{authorId} AND s.IsDeleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.Chapter SET Title = #{title}, Content = #{content}, WordCount = #{wordCount}, VolumeId = #{volumeId, jdbcType=INTEGER}, UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE ChapterId = #{chapterId} AND IsDeleted = 0 AND UpdatedAt = #{version}

UPDATE dbo.Chapter SET Status = 'SCHEDULED', ScheduledAt = #{scheduledAt}, UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE ChapterId = #{chapterId} AND IsDeleted = 0 AND Status IN ('DRAFT', 'SCHEDULED') AND WordCount > 0
UPDATE dbo.Chapter SET Status = 'DRAFT', ScheduledAt = NULL, UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE ChapterId = #{chapterId} AND IsDeleted = 0 AND Status = 'SCHEDULED'
UPDATE dbo.Chapter SET IsDeleted = 1, UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE ChapterId = #{chapterId} AND IsDeleted = 0
